# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Confirmed the branch already contains the approved shrimp molt/mineral and reproduction-default fixes from the prior review round, so this apply-fixes pass was validation-only and required no source edits. I rechecked the relevant TAN/NO2 suppression defaults, MarginalFailure/poor-condition diagnostic paths, and shrimp regression coverage, then reran focused and broad validation; all targeted suites passed on the current branch.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspected the current branch state and relevant shrimp parameter/diagnostic paths to confirm the approved fixes were already present before making any edits.
2. [Completed] Ran formatting and focused shrimp regression suites covering mineral-gated molting and reproduction-factor behavior.
3. [Completed] Ran the full `tank_core` suite plus downstream `tank_data` and `tank_scenarios` tests to confirm broader stability, then recorded this stage as validation-only because no new fixes were needed.

## Validation Evidence

- `git status --short`
- `rg -n "default_tan_repro_full_suppression_mg_n_per_l|default_no2_repro_full_suppression_mg_n_per_l|MarginalFailure|test_reserve_driven_poor_condition_reports_blended_factor" crates/tank_core crates/tank_data`
- `cargo fmt --all --check`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test molt_mineral_budget -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test reproduction_factors -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_data -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_scenarios -- --nocapture`

## Outstanding Risks

None identified.
